title: Publish per-driver evidence indexes
scope: Produce a capability/evidence matrix from revisioned reports and check documentation claims against it.
acceptance: Stale source/case hashes, absent cases and unsupported results cannot certify a mode.
Known failures remain visible and source/toolchain/device tuples are preserved.
evidence: PASS: evidence-index negative tests reject stale contract/source hashes, absent evidence and unsupported results; none can produce a qualified capability row.
PASS: published index preserves source commit, driver binary, device/driver and compiler/Slang/CUDA/DXC provenance from the revisioned Windows report.
PASS: 59 conformance tests, including byte-exact checked index/documentation generation; known historical failures, limitations, unsupported scopes and missing current results remain visible.
PASS: compiled conformance input/registry/comparator gates (3/3) and relocatable SDK install/input checks; installed evidence index hash matches the manifest.
LIMITATION: no current production-driver F5-01 result is registered, so the honest published matrix qualifies 0 capability records; supplemental reports cannot certify modes.
